title: Review deposits, tax and staff tips at checkout
summary: Understand how existing deposits, configured tax and explicit tips affect the amount due.

sections.title: Apply an existing appointment deposit
sections.body:
The checkout can offer a verified, unallocated deposit from this same appointment. Before saving, review **Deposit already paid** and its **Apply** choice. On an already saved sale, use **Apply appointment deposit** when shown.

Only the amount up to the sale balance is applied. Any excess remains separately identified; it is not another payment due and is not silently transferred from an unrelated visit. Never enter the same deposit again as another received payment.

sections.title: Add a staff tip
sections.body:
1. Before saving the sale, select **Add tip** or **Add / edit tip**.
2. Under **Tip for**, choose the staff member.
3. Enter **Tip amount**, or use an offered percentage. Percentages use the discounted subtotal.
4. Select **Save tip**. Add a separate allocation for another staff member if needed.
5. Review the total and staff allocations before **Review & save sale**.

Tips are separate from commission. Recorded staff attribution and discounts can affect commission; do not change a performer merely to move someone else’s earnings.

sections.title: Understand the totals and limits
sections.body:
The sale shows **Tax included** or **Tax added**, using the business’s supported commerce settings and the recorded item values. A service’s tax-category label does not independently select a different tax rate in this release.

Checkout records payments already received. A deposit-status page is not necessarily a supported payment interface, and customer cancellation does not itself execute a refund. Ask an owner to review an unexpected amount before saving the fixed sale; this workspace cannot amend a saved basket.
